name: SpacePeek
soft_passes: #1 squircle baked into the PNG (transparent corners) not full-bleed unmasked; system would double-mask; corner curve rounder than macOS 26 continuous squircle
#3 silhouette is busy (folder tab + ring + handle); needs colour to fully parse as loupe-over-folder
#4 16px survives only via the multicolour ring; folder (1.13:1) and thin glass handle collapse at menu-bar size
#6 six-hue focal ring exceeds the <=2 hue-family guideline; justified as meaningful multicolour (disk segments) in one focal element
#9 hybrid era: Big Sur composition + baked specular, but Liquid-Glass translucency grafted on; conventions unreconciled
#10 fixed-background baked raster with intrinsically-multicolour focal element has no coherent tinted/mono variant path
failures: #7 figure-ground: folder #69BBFC on bg #69ADFB = 1.13:1 (floor 3:1); folder defined only by baked edge shadow, vanishes in grayscale/small; ring segments also weak vs field (blue 1.46, gold 1.48, white 2.06)

palette.background: ramp #97C3FC->#5C68F7 (top-light periwinkle -> bottom indigo, slight diagonal)
palette.accent: none — the multicolour ring is the accent (no single reserved hue)

light_model: top-down soft, one consistent direction (upper-left); baked specular on ring rim + magnifier glass; short soft contact shadows under ring and folder — Big Sur baked-light convention (Liquid Glass would defer specular to the system)
layer_stack: glass magnifier handle to bottom-right (ring serves as its lens)
devices: ring-as-lens: disk-usage donut chart doubles as the magnifier lens (the icon's whole idea in one shape)
diagonal glass tool overlay (magnifier handle breaks the front plane to the corner — Preview/loupe lineage)
in-product artifact quotation: ring palette directly quotes the app's own multicolour donut chart (icon shows the exact object you'll use)
ghosted translucent folder (background ramp reads through it — Liquid-Glass flourish on a Big-Sur base)
rhymes_hint: multicolour-diagnostic utility on a blue glass field — disk-usage segmented-ring icons (DaisyDisk/GrandPerspective lineage) re-housed on a friendly blue squircle, crossed with Apple's loupe-over-content utility family (Preview/Finder search)
notes: 512x512 web render (not the 1024 master) — no micro-measurement trust. Squircle + all effects (specular, translucency, contact shadows) baked into the raster; reads as a rendered/likely-AI-generated app icon (over-smooth gradients, soft imprecise folder edges), NOT a hand-authored layered Icon Composer file. Its one real non-template move is the ring-as-lens double-duty. Strong palette coherence between icon and cover: the icon ring quotes the in-app donut chart and the blue family matches the app's UI accent.
